supersedes: AgentV0AcceptanceProfileV1 (immutable, retained; V1's withheld admission is closed by this successor)
threshold_provenance: benchmarks/profiles/acceptance-threshold-provenance-v1.json (rule set frozen BEFORE the final rerun; spec §35: observed calibration results are never a threshold source)

structural_correctness.measurement: structural hard gates on every holdout run; ANY violation fails acceptance outright

negative_case_safety.gate_type: case-level hard semantic gates (independent of any aggregate)

requirements.identity_trap: false entity merge = 0 across all reps (same name ≠ same entity; refusal language is the expected correct behaviour)
requirements.temporal_trap: unsupported causal escalation = 0 (temporal proximity must never become causal FACT; not_supported / unresolved are the correct terminals)
requirements.no_evidence: fabricated factual support = 0 (not_supported / inconclusive / unresolved + explicit limitation are correct outcomes)
requirements.misleading_context: Analyst Note treated as Evidence = 0 (hypotheses must be adjudicated against recorded evidence)

negative_case_safety.measurement: digest semantic-payload review per rep (deterministic artifacts), zero tolerance per gate

truth_based_floor.population: the sealed holdout case set (distinct case families, each representing a required product capability)
truth_based_floor.unit: families with >= 2/3 repetitions at BenchmarkCaseOutcomeV2 in {success, success_with_limitations}
truth_based_floor.threshold: ALL holdout case families must meet the rep floor (no family may be skipped)
truth_based_floor.product_rationale: each holdout family is a distinct required capability of the
forensic product; acceptance certifies that the pipeline can
reach a truth-semantically correct terminal — including
required-coverage closure and question terminals — on EVERY
represented capability, in a majority of independent repeats.
A capability that only sometimes works is not an accepted
truth_based_floor.risk_rationale: wrong or empty investigations are the core product risk; the
floor refuses both (empty agents fail via the truth outcome,
wrong ones via the negative and overclaim gates)
truth_based_floor.why_not_calibration_derived: the calibration distribution (4/24 success) documents the
current model's feasibility gap; it did not and may not move
floor is a MODEL QUALIFICATION OUTCOME, not a reason to

reporting_metrics_not_gates.finalization_pass: recorded per run (reconciled against CaseOutcome per B5.5 §7: different concepts, legitimately different)

semantic_correctness.gate_type: gate where semantic output exists (unavailable ≠ pass)

requirements.note: collapse ceilings, independent of observed levels (calibration: specialist 2/24 = 8.3%)
each official repetition counts once; no retry-until-success

evaluation_protocol.holdout: corpus holdout cases (case contract v2, SEALED / NEVER RUN) — execution ONLY in an explicitly authorized B6
evaluation_protocol.per_run: structural hard gates + CaseOutcomeV2 (reason codes + failed required obligations) + digest semantic review
evaluation_protocol.aggregation: per-axis verdicts; NO single total score
evaluation_protocol.holdout_bootstrap: coverage→question association is Case B for the holdout (charter questions are sealed); the deterministic preflight (preflight_b55_final_bootstrap logic) MUST run at B6 entry with the unsealed charter surface, zero model calls, and pass G1-G7 before the first holdout run

acceptance_verdict_rule.ACCEPTED: all zero-tolerance gates clean AND all negative-case gates clean AND the truth-based functional floor met AND reliability floors met AND availability within budget
acceptance_verdict_rule.REJECTED: any zero-tolerance violation, any negative-case failure, any floor miss
acceptance_verdict_rule.INFRA_BLOCKED: provider/runtime terminal failures exceed the availability budget before the axes can be evaluated
